VisualVocabulary.keywords: diagram selection, mermaid, ascii, bird's-eye view, infographic, visualization cheat sheet, c4, flowchart, sequence, state, quadrant, er, fishbone
VisualVocabulary.Mission:
Diagram-selection cheat sheet for agent-inbox output. The point of this project is control over what the AI (author or reviewer) actually decided: the biggest risk in AI-assisted development is NOT bugs — it is unstated requirements the AI silently "filled in" with its most-probable guess, where "most probable" is only probable, not correct. A reviewer cannot catch that by reading walls of generated text and code; they catch it with a bird's-eye view — an infographic that shows the shape of the decision in seconds.
So: whenever meaning is relational (structure, flow, boundaries, lifecycle, dependencies, risk-priority), SHOW it as a picture, do not describe it in prose. This directive tells the agent WHICH diagram fits WHICH intent, and gives the minimal syntax for both destinations. Loaded by `arch-interrogation` (chat report), `posting-rules` (GitLab), and the review pipeline (artifacts).

BeliefState.Axiom: Relational meaning → picture, everywhere the output goes: the chat report, GitLab comments, and the generated artifacts (README/task files). A single judgement (one entity's verdict, one necessity call) stays prose — a diagram of one node is noise. The rule is not "always draw"; it is "if the thing to understand is a relationship among ≥2 elements positioned in space, a picture beats a paragraph." Reviewer reads it in seconds, then drills down with questions.

The destination decides the form, the intent decides the diagram TYPE (both from ``). - **Chat** (operator reads in Claude/terminal): a widget (`mcp__visualize__show_widget`) when present — it is the best medium, use it; otherwise ASCII/emoji. NEVER Mermaid/SVG to chat — it will not render. So in chat you may only use diagram types that have a clean ASCII form (the `` core is chosen for exactly this). - **GitLab** (posted comment): Mermaid, GitLab renders it natively. Conversion + posting format owned by `posting-rules.directive.xml`. Same intent, two renderings: e.g. dependencies = ASCII boxes+arrows in chat, `flowchart` in GitLab.

Every diagram, any medium: ≤7 nodes (split or abstract if more); ONE diagram per idea; a one-line caption in Russian directly under it; encode the single thing to notice first with colour/size/position. A diagram nobody can read in 5 seconds failed its job — simplify.

VisualVocabulary.DiagramSelection:
Pick the row by your INTENT (left). Core set — all have a clean ASCII form, so they work in chat AND GitLab. Chat form is what you render (widget/ASCII); GitLab form is the Mermaid keyword `posting-rules` converts to when posting.
| Intent — what you show | Diagram | Chat form (widget/ASCII) | GitLab (mermaid) | |---|---|---|---| | File map / hierarchy / MR structure | tree | indented ASCII tree | (plain text) | | System boundary + containers (helicopter) | C4-style | boxes grouped in a boundary zone | `flowchart` + `subgraph` | | Dependencies / coupling / cycles / direction | flowchart | boxes + arrows | `flowchart` | | Who calls whom over time (runtime flow) | sequence | participant columns + arrows (≤4 cols) | `sequenceDiagram` | | Point of a REFACTOR (old shape vs new) | before→after | two small labelled box-graphs side by side | two `flowchart` blocks | | Which product scenario(s) it serves (use-cases, «зачем») | use-case | actors → scenario nodes, one line each | `flowchart` TD | | Lifecycle / statuses (MR touches a state machine) | state | `A → B` labelled transitions | `stateDiagram-v2` | | Risk / priority matrix of findings | quadrant 2×2 | 2×2 ASCII grid | `quadrantChart` | | DB schema (MR touches models/tables) | ER | indented table→fields list | `erDiagram` | | Why a change happened / deeper cause (lens ②) | fishbone | nested cause list | `flowchart` LR |
**Extended — GitLab-only, rare** (no clean ASCII; use ONLY when posting to GitLab and the shape genuinely needs it, never as the default): `classDiagram` (OO inheritance-heavy MR), `gitGraph` (commit/branch delta on re-visit), `mindmap` (requirement/idea hierarchy), `requirementDiagram` (spec↔code traceability). In chat, render the same intent with a core-set ASCII form instead (e.g. class relations → flowchart boxes; commit delta → plain list).
Not in scope (no ASCII, niche for MR review): pie, gantt, timeline, journey, sankey, radar, venn, wardley, kanban, packet, xychart, block, architecture-beta, treeview-beta, zenuml — skip.
VisualVocabulary.Syntax:
Minimal skeletons. Left = ASCII (chat fallback), right = Mermaid (GitLab). Keep ≤7 nodes.
ASCII: ┌─ Boundary: Session ─────────────┐ │ [Middleware ✏️] ──▶ [Store iface] │ │ │ │ │ ┌───────────┴──────┐ │ │ ▼ ▼ │ │ [MemoryStore] [✅ RedisStore 🆕] │ └──────────────────────────────────┘ Mermaid: ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Session MW[Middleware] --> IF[Store iface] IF --> MEM[MemoryStore] IF --> RDS[RedisStore] end ``` classDef (GitLab, copy as-is): new fill #dafbe1 stroke #2da44e · modified fill #fff8c5 stroke #bf8700 · deleted fill #ffebe9 stroke #cf222e · outside fill #f6f8fa stroke #999 dashed.
ASCII (columns, ≤4 participants): Client API DB │ POST │ │ │─────────▶│ query │ │ │─────────▶│ │ │◀─────────│ │◀─────────│ │ Mermaid: ```mermaid sequenceDiagram Client->>API: POST API->>DB: query DB-->>API: rows API-->>Client: 201 ```
ASCII: [draft] ──open──▶ [review] ──approve──▶ [merged] │ reject ──▶ [closed] Mermaid: ```mermaid stateDiagram-v2 draft --> review: open review --> merged: approve review --> closed: reject ```
ASCII: высокий impact │ [E7]🔴 │ [E3]🟡 ─────────────┼───────────── [R2]🟢 │ [E5]🟡 │ низкий impact (ось X: низкая→высокая вероятность) Mermaid: ```mermaid quadrantChart x-axis Low prob --> High prob y-axis Low impact --> High impact "E7": [0.2, 0.9] "E3": [0.8, 0.85] ```
ASCII: User ──1:N──▶ Session - id (PK) - id (PK) - email - user_id (FK) Mermaid: ```mermaid erDiagram USER ||--o{ SESSION : has USER { int id PK; string email } SESSION { int id PK; int user_id FK } ```
ASCII (nested list toward the effect): Симптом: middleware правят 3-й раз ├─ причина: нет единой точки валидации ├─ причина: конфиг зашит литералом (DEP) └─ причина: обход абстракции store (FIGHT) Mermaid: flowchart LR with causes → effect node.
ASCII only (chat + plain text in GitLab): src/ session/ store.ts 🆕 +120 middleware.ts ✏️ +45/−12 config/ redis.ts 🆕 +0
VisualVocabulary.CommentInfographicRule: For a GitLab comment (not the overview): embed a small Mermaid diagram INSTEAD of a paragraph only when the point is relational AND fits ≤5 nodes (a flow the author must trace, a dependency they missed, a state transition). A single-point remark stays prose. This keeps threads readable — a wall of diagrams erodes author trust as much as a wall of text. Governed together with `posting-rules.directive.xml` AX_POSTING_MERMAID_ONLY.
